---
title: "11.16_Cipro_BZB_wt+A6_NEW"
format: html
editor: visual
---

#import file

```{r}
#make sure you set the folder where your file is saved as the current working directory
#check whether the excel file names are the same and don't change the dataframe name
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)

#Put in file names
cipro_BZB_1.5h <- read_excel("11.16_Cipro_BZB_wt+A6_NEW.xlsx", sheet="first")
cipro_BZB_15h <- read_excel("11.16_Cipro_BZB_wt+A6_NEW.xlsx", sheet="second") #wells get overflow after the 83th cycle
key_ref <- read_excel("11.16_Cipro_BZB_wt+A6_NEW.xlsx", sheet="keys")
```

#clean and combine

```{r}
cipro_BZB_1.5h$"Cycle" <- as.numeric(cipro_BZB_1.5h$"Cycle")

cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle" <- as.numeric(cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle")
```

```{r}
cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle" <- cipro_BZB_15h$"Cycle" + 90
```

```{r}
cipro_BZB_15h$"Time_s" <- cipro_BZB_15h$"Time_s" + 5400

```

```{r}
combined_df <- bind_rows(cipro_BZB_1.5h, cipro_BZB_15h)
```

```{r}
#preserve both cycle nr. and time
pivoted_OD <- combined_df %>%
pivot_longer(cols = -c(1,2), names_to = "well_ID", values_to = "OD")
```

```{r}
#change Time [s] to Time [h]
df_clean <- pivoted_OD%>%
  mutate(Time_min=round(Time_s/60,1),
         Time_h=round(Time_min/60,1))%>%
  select(Cycle, Time_h, Time_min, everything())
  
```

#add a key col

```{r}
df_clean<- left_join(df_clean, key_ref[, c("well_ID", "key", "cipro_ug_mL", "trial", "trial_rep", "trial_ID")], by = "well_ID")

df_clean$cipro_ug_mL<-factor(as.numeric(df_clean$cipro_ug_mL))

```

#calculate mean from replicates

```{r}
df_summarise <- df_clean %>%
  filter(trial != "test") %>%
  group_by(Time_h, trial, cipro_ug_mL) %>%
  summarise(
    min=min(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    max=max(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(OD, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    CV = sd/mean,
    log_mean = log10(mean),
    lower_error = log10(mean) - log10(mean - sd),
    upper_error = log10(mean + sd) - log10(mean))

```

#plot curves

```{r}
BZB_wt_curve<- df_summarise |>
  filter(trial == "wt") |>
ggplot( 
       aes(x = Time_h, y = mean, color = cipro_ug_mL)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  #geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean-sd, ymax = mean+sd, color = cipro_ug_mL), width = 0.2)+
   labs(title = "Ciprofloxacin-BZB Kiling Curve",
        subtitle = "Initial CFU ~ 5*10^5/mL per well, Strain = wt",
        y="Mean OD",
        caption = str_wrap("Cipro conc. is diluted by 1.5-fold; Growth control: cipro conc.= 0; MHB-only blank: cipro conc.= NA", width = 35))

BZB_wt_curve

#set working directory before saving!
ggsave("./plots_ggsave/Cipro_BZB_wt_NEW_111626.png", plot = BZB_wt_curve, width = 7, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

## curves of replicates

```{r}
BZB_wt_reps<- df_clean |>
  filter(trial == "wt") |>
ggplot(aes(x = Time_h, y = OD, color = cipro_ug_mL)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line()+
  facet_wrap(~trial_rep)+
   labs(title = "Ciprofloxacin-BZB Kiling Curve Triplicate",

        y="OD",
```
